caption.text:
PT Rans Entertainment Indonesia resmi melakukan IPO dan melantai di Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI). Di tengah momen bersejarah tersebut, kesuksesan korporat ini justru diwarnai aksi romantis yang memikat perhatian publik.

Raffi Ahmad tampak memeluk dan mencium sang istri, Nagita Slavina, di depan para kolega. Tak hanya itu, momen manis saat keduanya kompak mengenakan blazer hitam dan berbagi segelas air berdua di atas panggung langsung viral. Netizen pun ramai menyebut mereka sebagai definisi nyata dari tumbuh bersama orang yang tepat.

#RaffiAhmad #NagitaSlavina
caption.text_translation:
PT Rans Entertainment Indonesia officially conducts IPO and lands in Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI). In the midst of those historic moments, this corporate success was precisely colored by a romantic act that captured the public's attention.

Raffi Ahmad was seen hugging and kissing his wife, Nagita Slavina, in front of colleagues. Not only that, the sweet moment when the two of them together wore a black blazer and shared a glass of water together on stage went viral. Netizens are many calling them the real definition of growing up with the right people.

 #RaffiAhmad #NagitaSlavina
